beats.say: The five stages of deciding where to eat.
beats.title: the 5 stages of deciding where to eat

beats.say: Stage one. Confidence. I'm not picky.
Stage two. Someone says anything is fine. It is not fine.
beats.cap: Stage two. Someone says anything is fine. It is *not* fine.

beats.say: Stage three. Forty minutes on your phone. Nothing looks good.
Stage four. Grief. You eat cereal. For dinner. Again.
beats.cap: Stage four. Grief. You eat *cereal.* For dinner. Again.

beats.say: Stage five. Finding out there are {w} places to eat within a 10-minute walk of you.
Savor Scout dot net. Stages one through four are optional.
